winner.reason: The claimed ticket was a synthesis/documentation refresh. The updated analysis report now summarizes the latest bounded report set, adds method-winner rows with CIs, and revises caveats and open-question status.

updated_sections: Source Reports Read for This Chapter
scientific_summary: The refresh reinforces the previous synthesis: boosted trees and other ML methods win well-labeled closure or simulation-truth tasks, but support-changing applications remain gated by externalization. Dynamic-only timing remains a traditional median-first timing win; overlay pile-up classifiers win synthetic overlay ranking but do not yet transfer to real high-current candidates; dynamic-selector charge closure wins duplicate-readout closure but fails the event-external proxy; S17a gives a strong GEANT4 truth-side HGB PID ranking win that is not yet a data calibration.
